finalFourEngineDecision.question: Which calculator behavior is demonstrably accepted, and what is blocked without independent source evidence?
finalFourEngineDecision.evidenceStandard: Real same-effective-input two independent browser observations plus independently calculated results; mathematical unit tests without reference are LOCAL_ONLY

accepted: Local exact four-slot top-5 optimizer for 13 selectable weighted metrics and declared constraints; independent brute-force test oracle
One reference Poise-only Wretch medium-load maximum of 70 observed in a specific constrained scene
549 source-identified original armor weight/Poise pairs and 515 accepted stat-neutral 12-field items retained without rerun
notAccepted: Tarnished.dev top-five exact order and tie-breaking
Complete DLC candidate pool and effects
Exact parity of all 13 reference weighting/limit semantics
blockers: Legal, versioned complete DLC armor candidate catalogue including contextual stat-changing effects
An independent same-input 13-metric reference score/rank dataset with exact settings and tie cases

accepted: User-entered attack channels, per-hit motion values, target defense/negation and per-move timing; deterministic mathematical DPS from entered frames
Three observed +25 Standard Uchigatana source AR values 376,388,392; these are AR, not real enemy damage
Browser and unit tests cover per-hit values, frame validation and per-hit defense application
notAccepted: Automated per-weapon animation and recovery frames
Versioned enemy defense/negation, NG+ and PvP scaling
Tarnished.dev moveset DPS numeric equivalence; real in-game damage
blockers: Verifiable versioned enemy per-type defense/negation, NG+ and PvP parameters
Move-specific motion values, frame timings and real same-input damage/DPS goldens

Reopen only the specific blocked functionality when a genuinely new independent source or game-client observation exists. Never reinterpret CI green as whole-engine numerical parity.
